note: The entry is the stay case's [[representation.delivery_metadata]] for 1.5.ku, authored from _sources/scb-delivery-names-ku-agi (that case's delivery, unchanged) and built from the changed delivery below. The stale row's subject is the entry's `variable` and its locator the entry's file, table and index, both read from the curation fixture. A stale entry withholds its decision (the replaced tests assert `decision is None`); without the checked names KU's two delivery names conflict, so KU forms no state. Value from the replaced test: Registersyfte 'Changed' makes the parent-fact case stale. Every row changes, so the delivery has one register purpose and raises no parent conflict. Its 'column_name-only variable guard stays applicable' leg is not portable: such guards are compiled and captured fresh in each build.
fails_if: `parent_fact_projection` (reg_meta_build/src/reg_meta_build/source_curation.py) projects only a parent's name, so the changed register purpose no longer differs from the authored parent facts and the delivery metadata still applies
